text: Companies House's register of persons with significant control lists one active person with significant control for Paul Robinson Solicitors LLP (company OC300127): Mr Samuel Paul Robinson, with ownership of voting rights of 75% or more and the right to appoint or remove members.
short: Samuel Paul Robinson holds 75% or more of the voting rights in Paul Robinson Solicitors LLP (Companies House).
